description.fun: Mantyke is a friendly little manta ray with a smiley face on its back that swims up to boats and plays near the surface with schools of Remoraid, and it's a big hit on beach swimming tours. Those Remoraid are its ticket to growing up: it's the only Pokémon that needs one particular species in the party to evolve, a nod to real-life mutualism.
description.guide: A Water- and Flying-type baby Pokémon introduced in Generation 4, the pre-evolution of Mantine. It is friendly and often swims with schools of Remoraid. It evolves into Mantine when levelled up with a Remoraid in the party.
description.tagline: A smiley baby manta that grows up with help from Remoraid

description.fun: Build up enough speed and Mantine can burst out of the sea and fly 100 metres, so early observers often mistook it for a bird. Schools of Mantine race one another, often with a Remoraid clinging under a fin to eat their leftovers, which Mantine doesn't mind a bit. In Alola, surfers ride Mantine between the islands, and it's a regional icon on postcards and posters.
description.guide: A large Water- and Flying-type manta ray Pokémon that can leap out of the sea and glide. It is often seen with a Remoraid attached to its fin. It evolves from Mantyke, a baby Pokémon added in Generation 4.
description.tagline: A sea-going glider that Alola's surfers ride between islands

transitions.how: Level up, with Remoraid in the party

note.text: Mantyke is a baby Pokémon added in Generation 4, two generations after Mantine. It evolves when levelled up with a Remoraid in the party, and until Generation 8 a Mantine had to hold a Wave Incense for its Egg to hatch into Mantyke.
